interrupted: Interrupt sent — {who}'s turn stops, the session lives on
stopAll: Safe-stop all lanes? Each lane finishes its current work, commits, writes a handoff, then stops.
local.handoff: [cc-slaves] /handoff — safe-stopping {n} lanes, each writes a handoff
local.new: [cc-slaves] /new — the old session is writing its handoff…
switching: Moving {name} to {to} — resumes the same session
